q: The probability distribution function of a random variable X is given by f(x) = x/18 for 0 <= x <= 6, and 0 otherwise. Then the value of P(X > 2) is
explanation: P(X>2) = integral from 2 to 6 of x/18 dx = [x^2/36] from 2 to 6 = (36-4)/36 = 8/9.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Find the probability of guessing correctly at least six of 10 answers in a True or False objective test.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: If, for a binomial distribution, the number of trials is 9, the variance is 2 and the probability of success is greater than that of failure, find the probability of success.
explanation: npq = 2 with n = 9 gives pq = 2/9, so p and q are 2/3 and 1/3. Since p > q, p = 2/3.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Two customers, Rachana and Bhakti, visit a shop in the same week (Tuesday to Saturday). Each is equally likely to visit on any day. What is the probability that both visit on consecutive days?
explanation: Total outcomes 5x5 = 25. Consecutive ordered pairs: 4 pairs of days x 2 orders = 8. Probability = 8/25.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: A pendulum swings through an angle of 30 degrees and describes an arc of 17.6 cm in length. Find the length of the pendulum.
explanation: s = r*theta, theta = 30 deg = pi/6 = 0.5236 rad, so r = 17.6/0.5236 = 33.6 cm.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Two cubes each of volume 64 cm^3 are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the resulting cuboid.
explanation: Side = 4 cm, cuboid is 8 x 4 x 4, surface area = 2(8*4 + 4*4 + 8*4) = 160 cm^2.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The incomes of A, B and C are in the ratio 7 : 9 : 12 and their spendings are in the ratio 8 : 9 : 15. If A saves 1/4 of his income, then the savings of A, B and C are in the ratio
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Two trains A and B start simultaneously from stations 300 km apart, at 60 km/h and 90 km/h towards each other. A bird flies from A towards B at 120 km/h, turning back each time it reaches a train, until the trains meet. What total distance does the bird cover?
explanation: The trains meet after 300/150 = 2 hours, so the bird flies 120 x 2 = 240 km.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Find the distance from the eye at which a coin of 2 cm diameter should be held so as to conceal the full moon whose angular diameter is 31 minutes.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: A circular wire of radius 7.5 cm is cut and bent to lie along the circumference of a hoop of radius 120 cm. Find the angle subtended at the hoop's centre.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The population of a town grows at 10 percent per year (continuously). How long will it take for the population to triple?
explanation: dP/dt = 0.1P gives t = ln 3 / 0.1 = 10 ln 3.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The coefficients of x^n in the expansions of (1+x)^(2n) and (1+x)^(2n-1) are in the ratio
explanation: C(2n,n) / C(2n-1,n) = 2, so the ratio is 2 : 1.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The equation of a parabola is y^2 = 4x. Which of the following points lie on the parabola?
explanation: For (4, 4): y^2 = 16 and 4x = 16, so the point satisfies the equation.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: In triangle ABC the sides are a = 9, b = 7, c = 12. Find angle C using the Law of Cosines.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The number of real solutions of sqrt(1 + cos 2x) = sqrt(2) * arccos(cos x) in [pi/2, pi] is
explanation: LHS = sqrt(2)|cos x| = -sqrt(2) cos x on this interval and RHS = sqrt(2) x, so -cos x = x, impossible since x >= pi/2.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Given dy/dx + y = 1 with y(0) = 2, find y(1).
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The perpendicular distance of the point P(1, 2, 3) from the line (x-6)/3 = (y-7)/2 = (z-7)/(-2) is
explanation: With A(6,7,7), AP = (-5,-5,-4), |AP|^2 = 66 and the projection on the direction is -sqrt(17), so distance^2 = 66 - 17 = 49, distance = 7.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: The projections of a line segment on the X, Y, Z axes are 12, 4, 3 respectively. The length and direction cosines are
explanation: Length = sqrt(144+16+9) = 13 and each direction cosine is the projection divided by 13.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Find the total number of ways to put 20 distinct balls into 5 boxes so that the first box contains exactly one ball.
explanation: Choose the single ball for box 1 in 20 ways; each of the remaining 19 balls goes to any of the other 4 boxes: 20 x 4^19.
subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: Find the number of arrangements of the letters of the word INDEPENDENCE such that (i) the word starts with I and ends with P, and (ii) all the vowels never occur together.

subject: Mathematics & Statistics

q: A study found that employees who worked fewer hours per week were more productive. Which of the following, if true, weakens the study's conclusion?
options: Companies with reduced working hours had fewer operational delays.
Employees with reduced working hours demanded higher wages.
Employees in creative fields showed the highest productivity improvement.
Companies with reduced hours reported higher profits.
explanation: A demand for higher wages offsets the claimed benefit, weakening the case for reducing working hours.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: In a certain code SAND is written as UCPF. How is STONE written in that code?
explanation: Each letter moves forward by 2, so STONE becomes UVQPG.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd one.
explanation: The first three are worn on the eyes; an optical reader is a device.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Look at this series: 53, 53, 40, 40, 27, 27, ... What number should come next?
explanation: Each pair decreases by 13, so after 27, 27 comes 14.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: In a certain language BOOK is written as 4300 and MATE as 3900. Then 1600 represents which word?
explanation: The code is the sum of alphabet positions times 100. CAGE = 3+1+7+5 = 16, giving 1600.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: If CLAUSE is coded as ECSLUA, then the code of UMPIRE will be
explanation: The letters are re-ordered as positions 6,1,5,2,4,3. For UMPIRE that gives E, U, R, M, I, P.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Birds sit on trees A and B: if 2 birds move from B to A the numbers become equal; if 2 move from A to B then B becomes double of A. Find the number of birds on A and B.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: How many pairs of letters are there in CAMBRIDGE that have as many letters between them in the word as in the English alphabet?
explanation: The valid pairs are A-G and I-G, so there are two such pairs.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Five friends A, B, C, D, E travel from Goa to Chennai, Kolkata, Delhi, Varanasi and Bangalore by bus, train, airplane, car and boat (all distinct). C goes to Bangalore by car, D travels by boat, B goes to Kolkata by airplane, E travels by train, the Delhi traveller did not use a boat, and there is no bus from Goa to Delhi or Chennai. Who travelled to Delhi?
explanation: A takes the bus, which cannot go to Delhi; D is ruled out by the boat condition and C goes to Bangalore, so E travelled to Delhi.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Statements: All incomes are salaries. Some salaries are perks. Some perks are tangible. Conclusions: (c1) Some incomes are tangible. (c2) At least some perks are salaries.
explanation: c2 is the converse of 'some salaries are perks' and always follows; c1 is not guaranteed.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: The six numbers 283, 347, 518, 829, 748, 827 are given. If the first and third digits of each number are interchanged, which number will be the third lowest?
explanation: After interchanging: 382, 743, 815, 928, 847, 728. Sorted, the third lowest is 743, which came from 347.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Teacher is related to school in the same way as cook is related to ......
explanation: A teacher works in a school just as a cook works in a kitchen.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: If the digits of 5734629 are arranged in ascending order from left to right, how many digits remain in the same position?
explanation: Ascending: 2345679. Comparing position by position, the digits 6 and 9 stay in place, so two digits.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: A man travels 2 km north, turns east and travels 10 km, again turns north and travels 3 km, then turns east and travels 2 km. How far is he from the starting point?
explanation: Net north = 5 km, net east = 12 km, distance = sqrt(25 + 144) = 13 km.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Ten years ago, the average age of A and B was 20 years. The average age of A, B and C today is 30 years. How old will C be after 5 years?
explanation: A + B = 60 today and A + B + C = 90, so C = 30 and after 5 years C is 35.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Find the odd one out.
explanation: Rose, tulip and lily are flowers; carrot is a vegetable.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Complete the analogy: Book : Reading :: Knife : ?
explanation: A book is used for reading just as a knife is used for cutting.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: What is the next number in the sequence: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
explanation: These are perfect squares, so the next term is 6^2 = 36.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Which word does not belong to the group?
explanation: Fox, wolf and bear are wild animals; a cat is domestic.

q: Complete the analogy: Pineapple : Fruit :: Carrot : ?
explanation: A pineapple is a fruit just as a carrot is a vegetable.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: Find the missing number in the series: 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
explanation: Each term is multiplied by 3, so the next term is 81 x 3 = 243.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: In a Venn diagram, what does the overlapping region of two sets A and B represent?
explanation: The overlap contains elements common to both sets, that is A intersection B.
subject: Logical / Abstract Reasoning

q: What is the opposite of Transparent?
explanation: Opaque means not able to be seen through, the opposite of transparent.

q: What type of verb is will in the sentence, I will go to the cinema?
explanation: Will is a helping (auxiliary) verb forming the future tense.

q: Which sentence uses a conjunction correctly?
options: He likes to read but he doesn't like to write.
He likes but to read he doesn't like to write.
He but likes to read doesn't like to write.
But he likes to read, he doesn't like to write.
explanation: But must join two independent clauses, as in the first option.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Choose the correct synonym for the word abundant.
explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantity, that is plentiful.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: In the story The Mysterious Garden, two children discover a magical hidden garden where a wise old tree gives them riddles, promising treasure if they succeed. What is the main conflict in the story?
explanation: The central challenge the children face is solving the riddles set by the tree.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Which word best describes something extremely ordinary and commonplace?
explanation: Mundane means dull, ordinary and everyday.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Which of the following sentences demonstrates irony?
options: The fire station burned down last night.
The sun rises in the east.
She is the tallest person in her class.
explanation: A fire station burning down is the opposite of what is expected, which is situational irony.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Read the passage: The ancient art of storytelling has been a cornerstone of human communication for millennia. Stories convey values, traditions and knowledge. In many cultures oral storytelling was the primary method of passing down history before written language. Today storytelling takes new forms, from novels to movies, but its core purpose remains the same. What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: To highlight the entertainment value of storytelling
To discuss the role and evolution of storytelling in human culture
To criticize modern forms of storytelling
explanation: The passage traces what storytelling does and how its forms have changed while its purpose stayed the same.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Based on the storytelling passage, what can be inferred about oral storytelling?
options: It became less significant after the advent of written language.
It was a less effective way of preserving history than written records.
It was the only form of entertainment in ancient cultures.
It was an essential method for preserving culture and history before written language.
explanation: The passage says oral storytelling was the primary way of passing down history before writing existed.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: What can be inferred from the statement: The new policy has left many employees disgruntled?
options: The employees are pleased with the policy.
The employees are unhappy with the policy.
The employees are indifferent to the policy.
The employees are confused by the policy.
explanation: Disgruntled means angry or dissatisfied.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Choose the correct option: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ responsible for the mistake.
explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, employees, so are is correct.
subject: English & Verbal Ability

q: Choose the correct word: The new policy aims to _______ equality among all citizens.
explanation: Ensure means to make certain that something happens.

q: The area of an equilateral triangle is 49*sqrt(3) cm^2. Taking each vertex as centre, circles are drawn with radius equal to half the side. Find the area of the triangle not included in the circles. (Take sqrt(3) = 1.73)
explanation: Side = 14, radius = 7. Triangle area = 84.77; three 60 degree sectors = 0.5 x pi x 49 = 76.97; difference = 7.8 which matches 7.77.

q: Identify the correct sentence.
options: She do not knows the answer.
explanation: With a third person singular subject, use doesn't followed by the base verb.

q: Two circles touch externally. The sum of their areas is 130*pi sq.cm and the distance between their centres is 14 cm. Find the radii of the circles.
explanation: r1 + r2 = 14 and r1^2 + r2^2 = 130 give r1*r2 = 33, so the radii are 11 and 3.

q: Read the passage: The invention of the printing press was a turning point in human history. options: It facilitated mass production of books.
It introduced the concept of the Enlightenment.
explanation: The passage states directly that the press enabled mass production of books.

q: Arrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph: 1. It ensures survival and fosters innovation. 2. Collaboration is vital in today's world. 3. Working together allows for diverse perspectives. 4. Teamwork leads to better solutions.

It's raining; I should take an umbrella.
Its raining I should take an umbrella.

options: The bouquet of flowers were on the table.
Each of the students have completed the assignment.
The committee has decided to postpone the meeting.

q: What is the main difference between a process and a thread?
options: A process is a lightweight task, while a thread is a heavyweight task
A thread has its own memory space, while a process shares memory
A process has its own memory space, while a thread shares the memory of the process
Threads cannot run concurrently, but processes can
explanation: Threads of a process share its address space, whereas each process has its own.

q: Which data structure uses the FIFO (First In, First Out) principle?
explanation: A queue removes elements in the order they were inserted.

explanation: The program counter stores the address of the next instruction.

q: The interval between the time of submission and the completion of a job is called
explanation: Turnaround time is completion time minus submission (arrival) time.

q: ________ is a technique of improving the priority of a process waiting in the queue for the CPU.
explanation: Ageing gradually raises the priority of long-waiting processes to prevent starvation.

q: What traversal method visits a binary tree in the order left subtree, root, right subtree?
explanation: That order defines inorder traversal.

q: What does the term RISC stand for in computer architecture?
explanation: RISC stands for Reduced Instruction Set Computer.

options: They generate machine code for the entire program at once.
They are faster than interpreters in error detection.
They are used to execute scripts dynamically.

q: Which of the following scheduling algorithms is non-preemptive?
explanation: FCFS runs each job to completion once it starts, so it is non-preemptive.

q: What is the hexadecimal representation of the binary number 10110111?
explanation: 1011 = B and 0111 = 7, so the value is B7 in hexadecimal.

q: Simplify the Boolean expression A.(B + C).
explanation: By the distributive law, A.(B + C) = AB + AC.
